tutorial.skipped: Tutorial skipped. You can pick it up again in Club, Settings.
tutorial.resumed: Tutorial back on: your assistant returns at the next step.

steps.welcome: Welcome, {manager}, I'm your assistant. Your first match is on {date} against {opponent}: kick it off, I'll stay right by your side.
steps.speed: The match plays out before your eyes: {seconds} seconds at {normal}. In a hurry? Switch to {fast} or {fastest}.
steps.choice: Your call: my advice is ticked, but you don't have to follow it.
steps.halfTime: In “{coaching}” you can bring a player on or change the instruction; otherwise, “{resume}”.
steps.halfTimeAdvice: My advice is already open: “{apply}”, then “{resume}”.
steps.halfTimeNoAdvice: Pick who comes off and who goes on, then “{resume}”.
steps.fullTime: First match done. Come back tomorrow: I'll have your first missions ready.
steps.missions: Three missions a day: an easy one, a medium one and a hard one. They earn you tokens, to spend in {club}, {rewards}.
steps.market: The transfer window shuts on {date}. I've spotted players for your weak spot, {position}: have a look at the {market}.
steps.marketProposal: Here's a player for your weak spot, within your means. “{sign}” if he suits you, “{pass}” for the next one.
steps.objectives: Here's what the board expects of you this season; I picked the last objective for you. Before your 5th match, it judges nothing.
steps.objectivesOwn: Here's what the board expects of you this season; the last one is your own pick. Before your 5th match, it judges nothing.
steps.lineup: {touch, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} a position: I'll show you who can play there, best first.
steps.lineupPick: Pick one, then “{save}”. Or keep mine: it's ready.
steps.lineupPush: Before your next match, open “{prepare}”: I'll show you who can play in each position.
steps.squad: The rating, from 1 to 99, sums up a player's level; the heart, his fitness. {touch, select, touch {Tap} other {Click}} a player to see his profile.
steps.simulate: No time to watch it all? “{simulate}” plays on to the date you choose, without the live match, and sums it up.
steps.break: The international break is coming: {count, plural, one {# of your players is} other {# of your players are}} off on international duty. They'll be back on Tuesday, tired if they played.
steps.breakNone: The international break is coming: a week without club matches, and none of your players is called up.
steps.europe: {competition}: {count} league-phase matches. The top four go straight to the quarter-finals, 5th to 12th into the play-offs.
steps.cup: Cup: a single match, with extra time and penalties if needed. Lose and you're out.
steps.fitness: {player} is tired ({fitness}): he'll play below par and could get injured. Rest him, or tap “{automatic}”.
steps.judged: Five matches in: the board starts judging. Its confidence now moves after every match.
steps.farewell: That's all from me. My advice stays in “{todo}”.
